author: groundedsi
description:
RoboCap-10k: A Metrically Accurate Egocentric Dataset for Robot Learning
	

10,000 curated hours of unscripted egocentric manipulation, recorded while people did their paid jobs, with metric 3D head and hand poses and two levels of language annotations.
Project page · Dataset files · Paper · Grounded Superintelligence

Data location: the data is in this repository, split into 412 shards under shards/. Each shard is a self-contained LeRobot v3.0 dataset of about 25 hours. Request… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/groundedsi/RoboCap-10k.
